answer: For a nursery's cultivation rewards, use a root-growth audit: enroll a lotus rhizome and a juniper cutting on a numbered greenhouse ledge, then have an independent inspector photograph their roots at enrollment and after 60 days. Match root patterns across claims and issue one reward per surviving plant, not per wallet. An extra account earns nothing from the same plants; an extra paid claim requires another pair, growing space, and 60 days of care. This limits reward farming, not identities everywhere.
